version.changelog: Added current model routing and practical API playbooks for modern AI video generation workflows.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: video-generation
Version: 1.0.1

The video-generation skill bundle is a comprehensive set of documentation and architectural guidelines designed to help an AI agent navigate various third-party video generation APIs (e.g., OpenAI Sora, Google Veo, Runway). It includes model routing logic, async API patterns, and local state management via a dedicated directory (~/video-generation/). The skill does not contain executable code, obfuscation, or instructions for data exfiltration; it explicitly advises against storing secrets in project files and limits external communication to legitimate AI provider endpoints listed in SKILL.md.

llm.summary: This is a coherent AI video-generation guidance skill that discloses its provider API use and scoped local preference memory.

dimensions.detail: The skill can send prompts, parameters, and optional media references to named third-party video providers, which is purpose-aligned and explicitly disclosed but may expose user content and incur provider costs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown-only with no executable files, no dependency installation, and no remote payload retrieval; optional environment variables are provider credentials expected for API use.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to video-generation workflows and contain no prompt hijacking, deception, hidden exfiltration, destructive automation, or unrelated authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It creates scoped local state under ~/video-generation/ for provider preferences and reusable recipes, with history marked optional; this is disclosed and proportionate, though users should review what gets saved.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities match its stated purpose: routing video-generation requests across providers, improving prompts, handling async jobs, and saving outputs before provider URLs expire.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable with sending prompts and any reference media you choose to the listed video providers, and periodically review ~/video-generation/memory.md or history.md if you do not want project preferences or cost notes retained locally.
llm.findings:
[EA2] expected: The cited text says not to ask users to paste secrets into chat and only checks environment-variable presence; it does not authorize destructive, financial, or high-impact autonomous actions.
[SQP-2] expected: Memory updates after meaningful sessions are purpose-aligned with reusable model routing and prompt recipes, and the main skill discloses local preference persistence under ~/video-generation/.
[SQP-2] expected: Creating ~/video-generation/ and copying a memory template is scoped local setup disclosed in metadata and setup instructions; no secrets are stored and persistent run logs are optional.
